10 REM! INTEGER I,J
20 DIM D%(7)
30 DEF FN F(X)=I
40 X$="TASC":FOR Q1=(-LEN(X$)) TO (J) STEP (LEN(CHR$(VAL(X$))))
50 PLOT AB=Q1-32767,40000
60 DATA -2.5,-2.5,X,300
70 IF (D%(PEEK(40000))) THEN PRINT:FOR J=(M) TO (Q1 AND Y%):FOR J=(I-255) TO (20)
80 FOR AB=(NOT ((M^((J*I))))) TO (N2 OR 0^((7/J))):Q1=NOT W-1000^146>A%+D%(307)-((I+N2)):Q1=Y%
90 GET I
100 CALL AB*255-((M%<=698))
110 A%(SIN(N2>1000)+D%(A%=39),FN F(-864)>=FN F(347))=I:HPLOT ((I<M))^((814/M))>=((FN F(A%) OR .001<Y%)),(J) TO D%(M%),(Z%)
120 PRINT XY$;XY$;:PLOT W,((3 OR ((M OR Q1))))<=N2*((Y%>A%))
130 N2$=MID$(X$,TAN(I^A%)):FOR M=(D%(INT(LEN(N2$)))) TO (M) STEP (3):M=11
140 CALL Y%
150 D%(ABS(NOT ((10^W))))=26322:ON FN F(J)<>FN F(10220)=EXP(J<1) GOTO 20,240,180
160 HCOLOR=7:DATA -2.5,300,
170 HOME:J=1:X$=XY$
180 N2=FN F(39):Y%=-N2
190 HCOLOR=48563*PEEK(A%(I,I)):PRINT 199;Y%,((((146 AND N2))>=PEEK(N2)))*N2,:Q1=ABS(255=N2)>=24
200 GOSUB 130:PRINT CHR$(Z% AND INT(509)),LEN("123")<>744,:NEXT M
210 Z%=A%:RESTORE
220 GOSUB 290:PRINT A%;:PRINT CHR$(((M OR 1E3))-((I<N2)));RIGHT$("HI"+"",Q1);FN F(49152),
230 Y%=N2>I:GOSUB 160:IF (0.1) THEN 80
240 FOR J=(Y%) TO (1 OR ((D%(0)+N2))*Z%):VTAB ABS(1 OR LOG(N2)):N2=((I-M))*((N2<>Z%=W^W))
250 FOR I=(Q1=M%) TO (FN F(LEN("X Y"))):PRINT
260 PRINT XY$;65535<M,:IF (N2+N2/Q1*486) THEN 150:HCOLOR=FN F(949)
270 A%(SGN(VAL(N2$)),27365)=Y%:N2=AB:NEXT I
280 HTAB A%:HCOLOR=ASC(XY$) AND 100
290 PRINT 22680+-FN F(18175),N2$;TAN(COS(J))<20165+LOG(W);:D%(J<((ABS(.5)>EXP(I))))=2:N2$=XY$
300 N2$=MID$(XY$,2>=((M=A%(Z%,3))))
